properties.rationale: Standing disposition for planned-but-unbuilt capabilities (user's 2026-07-23 call, applied again 2026-07-24): cap:session-memory was captured today and nothing is built, so a Verification would have nothing to run against. Worth naming the check it will need when it is built, because it is not the obvious one: the test is not "does a node get written" but "does a LATER session, with no memory of this one, find what this session decided by asking a question in its own words". That makes it an integration check spanning the trigger, the epoch anchor and the query surface — and it cannot pass while ver:search-natural-language is failing, since the query half is the same machinery. Sequence it after the foundation search fix lands.
